dedicated_capacity_sizing_recommendation: Initial recommended pool: 3 x A100-80GB (or equivalent H100) GPU nodes in a Dedicated pool with autoscale headroom of +50% during promos. Rationale: supports steady-state 3–6 QPS for generation model (13B-class quantized) with p95 latency target <400ms for common prompt sizes, plus ~10k embeddings/sec throughput with batching. Suggest enabling prefix/KV caching and 128ms batching window for cost efficiency. If customer opts for a larger-context model (32k tokens) bump to 4x GPUs. Include 2-week pilot with production traffic replay to validate network peering and batch profiles.
